    Manufacturing know-how

    The shop floor processes I know, from tube bending to carbon fibre.

    • Tube bending

      Bending aluminium, titanium and stainless steel tubes to tight aerospace tolerances.

    • Tube swaging

      Shaping tube ends with rotary swaging dies for strong, leak-tight fitting joints.

    • Tube expansion

      Expanding tube ends over a mandrel so they seat precisely in fittings and sleeves.

    • Welding

      Joining aerospace parts with qualified welding procedures.

    • Radiography

      X-ray inspection that checks welds and parts for hidden defects.

    • Heat treatment

      Controlled heating and cooling that gives metal parts the right strength.

    • Special processes

      Chemical treatments and finishes controlled to aerospace standards.

    • Sheet metal fabrication

      Cutting, forming and assembling sheet metal parts.

    • Composite parts manufacturing

      Carbon fibre parts in both monolithic laminates and sandwich builds with a honeycomb core.

    • CNC machining

      Precision machining of metal parts from programmed toolpaths.
